landmarks.name: Rifugio Nuvolau
landmarks.fact: Perched high on Mount Nuvolau, this historic alpine refuge built in 1883 offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the Dolomites.

landmarks.name: Cinque Torri
landmarks.fact: A striking rock formation of five towers near Cortina d'Ampezzo, famous for rock climbing and World War I historical trails.

landmarks.name: Rifugio Scoiattoli
landmarks.fact: A popular mountain hut situated opposite Cinque Torri, providing scenic outdoor dining and access to ski slopes and hiking routes.
